title: Pre-flattening intent and information-use evidence
summary: Structured Utterance exists to preserve communicative purpose, customer-data lineage, declared information use and contemporaneous generation intent before language is flattened. Cross-act information-use edges survive even when the final sales sentence contains no sensitive wording.
invariants: Purpose and privacy are orthogonal dimensions.
Declared information use is evidence, not authority; effective use is derived from the retained act/relation structure.
Sensitive-information commercial repurposing can be detected without retaining sensitive customer wording.
A privacy downgrade cannot be granted by the generating LLM itself.
Diagnostic markup is not the canonical storage format.
Structured Response is the wider producer point; Structured Utterance remains the language-specific projection rather than the owner of plans, durable facts or cognitive episodes.
A qualified Structured Utterance Producer may remain a standalone candidate until repository/portfolio admission; qualification is not registration.

provenance.claim: Pre-flattening purpose/lineage and native Interaction Event handoff.
Generation intent, information-use edges, declared/effective use mismatch and cross-act sensitive repurposing.
Provider-neutral pre-flattening producer seam; flattened reply is insufficient and native Structured Utterance semantic objects are reused.
